validation.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address
validation.url: Please enter a full address starting with https://
validation.positiveInteger: Please enter a whole number above zero
validation.phoneNumber: Enter the number in international notation, for example +4930123456
validation.positiveAmount: Please enter an amount greater than 0

link.title: Sign in
link.intro: Enter your e-mail address and we send you a link that signs you in. There is no password to remember.
link.done: Check your inbox. The link works once and is valid for 15 minutes.

signIn.title: Signing you in
signIn.working: One moment, your link is being checked.
signIn.invalid: This link is invalid, spent or expired. Ask for a new one.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.intro: Tell us your name to activate your account. You sign in with a link we e-mail you, so there is no password to remember.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Tell us where to reach you. Everything else you can add later.
register.done: Almost there. Open the e-mail we sent you to finish your account.
register.closed: This portal does not take sign-ups at the moment.
register.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app. A recovery code works here as well.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: No access to the app? Use one of your recovery codes.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: Welcome. Two steps and the portal is ready.

connection.title: 1. Connection to the service
connection.hint: Check the API key in the server configuration and try again.

admin.title: 2. Administrator account
admin.intro: This account manages users, branding and outgoing mail.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: A second factor protects your account even if someone else reaches your mailbox.
twoFactor.statusOn: Active. Every sign-in asks for a code as well.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.manual: Or type this key by hand:
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one replaces the code from the app once. They are shown now and never again.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Enter a current code from the app to confirm this.

warningMails.title: Warnings by email
warningMails.subtitle: We only send the warnings you switch on here, and only as often as you choose.
warningMails.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
warningMails.savedOn: Saved. This warning now arrives by email.
warningMails.savedOff: Saved. This warning no longer arrives by email.
warningMails.alwaysSent: Replies to your tickets and notices about the security of your account always arrive, whatever you choose here.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: When your balance drops below €5 and when it is almost used up.

balancePortal.title: Portal balance
balancePortal.description: When the portal balance drops below €5 and when it is almost used up.

trial.title: Starting credit
trial.description: When half or almost all of your starting credit is used and when your trial ends.

numbers.title: Phone numbers
numbers.description: When the review status of one of your phone numbers changes, for example because documents are missing.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: When a connected app can no longer be reached.

customerOrders.title: Your customers' purchases
customerOrders.description: When a customer could not buy a phone number, a plan or balance because something is missing on the portal side, or when a renewal failed.

impersonation.banner: You are viewing the portal as {{email}}.

notices.languageAdjusted: The language selection was adjusted to the chosen voice model.
